title: Boxing Out Hunger One Donation at a Time
imageAlt: Box Out For Hunger feature article cover
summary: Combining their love of basketball with compassion for community members struggling with food insecurity, NRCA juniors Carr Jennings and his friends Jeremiah Adeyanju, Asher Perry, and Charles Eyster decided to serve together. The four took collection boxes to their local community and AAU basketball tournaments this summer, where donations of nonperishables flooded in.
